description.value:
Seto Lions are red lion or wolf-like beasts that walk on all fours, though their sentience is on par with tribal-like races. They are long-lived and value honor and courage.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Seto Lions gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom and -2 Charisma.
  • Size: Seto Lions are Medium creatures.
  • Type: Seto Lions are Magical Beast creatures with a seto lion subtype.
  • Base Speed: Seto Lions have a base speed of 50 feet.
  • Languages: Seto Lions begin play speaking Common and Lionese. Seto Lions with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Cat's Luck: Once per day, seto lions can roll a Reflex save twice and take the better result.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Skill Bonus: Seto Lions gain a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatic checks.
  • Skill Training: Acrobatics and Climb are always class skills.

Magical Racial Traits

  • Everburning Tail: Seto Lions 30+ years old have a fiery tail tip that produces light and can deal fire damage.

Offence Racial Traits

  • Bite: Seto Lions gain a natural bite attack, dealing 1d3 points of damage.
  • Claws: Seto Lions receive two claw attacks that deal 1d4 damage.
  • Jaw Weapons: Seto Lions can wield light or one-handed weapons in their jaws.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Darkvision: Seto Lions can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.
  • Low-Light Vision: Seto Lions have low-light vision.

Other Racial Traits

  • Quadruped: Seto lions possess 4 legs, granting a +4 racial bonus to CMD against trip attempts.
